name: cyclic-pairs-4type
rationale: 4 pairs of goods on a 4-cycle; agent i values its own pair 10, next 6, then 3, then 1. 4 distinct rows (base not sigma-invariant). Cyclic-scarcity analogue of the 2605.06451 relabeling symmetry pushed to n=4.

name: cyclic-pairs-steep
rationale: Same 4-cycle, steeper spread {20,7,2,1} echoing the tri-valued chores gadget; steep spread shrinks the EFX cushion max_g v(g) relative to the envy gap.

name: chores-complement-2type-CONTROL
rationale: Direct negation/complement (v=21-cost) of the 2606.08872 tri-valued chores gadget. Only 2 distinct rows => 2 types => provably safe; included to CONFIRM the chores-complement collapses type count. Expect verifier: EFX exists.

name: chores-gadget-4group-4type
rationale: Goods-side re-imagining of the tri-valued chores costs lifted to a 4-cycle of good-groups with a 4th value; each agent 'hates' (values 1) a distinct group. 4 distinct rows -> escapes 3-type wall.

name: coverage-additive-shadow-CONTROL
rationale: Singleton shadow of the 2605.06451 weighted-coverage witness u0. sigma permutes only equal-valued A/B/C goods => all 4 rows identical => 1 type => provably safe. Included to CONFIRM naive shadowing collapses both value spread and type count. Values slightly >20 by design (faithful shadow).

name: sat-inspired-latin-rotation
rationale: The 2604.18216 SAT witness is 'far from additive' with hidden tables; best additive analogue is maximal pairwise disagreement. Wide value spread cyclically rotated so no two agents rank goods alike. 4 distinct rows.

name: cyclic-pairs-m9
rationale: C1 with a 9th low-value shared good; probes whether odd m / an extra contested crumb breaks the cyclic-pairs balance. 4 distinct rows.

name: tri-valued-contested-m9
rationale: 4 contested top goods (0..3), agent i uniquely craves good i (20) and disdains the other three (1); 5 shared filler goods worth 3. Forces two agents to miss their craved good -> envy stress test. 4 distinct rows, distinct enough that removal of any single good from an envied bundle leaves the craved good.

name: distinct-multiset-4type-INSURANCE
rationale: Four genuinely different value MULTISETS (not permutations of one another): 2-loved, 3-loved-medium, 3-loved-low, and flat. Unambiguously 4 types under ANY definition of 'type' (rows OR up-to-relabeling). Insurance against a safety theorem that counts types up to good-relabeling.
